about.title: About
about.bio: I studied Graphic Design at Universidad Nacional de Cuyo and trained in UX/UI (Coderhouse and Codo a Codo). For 5+ years I have designed for public institutions, companies and agencies. I'm looking for remote work only.
about.experienceText: I have designed for ISCAMEN (Lead Digital Designer since 2021), Grupo Nexia and Sette Agency, and for brands such as MoonDesk, Condimento, Carpa, RLB and Interlink: social media, performance ads, email marketing, ebooks, WordPress websites and Figma systems.
about.aiText: I work closely with teams, from brief to final delivery, and use AI to produce faster without giving up design judgement: ChatGPT for ideas and draft copy, Nano Banana to generate and edit images, Claude Code for websites and design systems, and ElevenLabs for voices.
